encode.base64_encode.name: Base64 encode
encode.base64_encode.description: Encodes the UTF-8 bytes of the text as Base64.

encode.base64_decode.name: Base64 decode
encode.base64_decode.description: Decodes Base64 or URL-safe Base64, ignoring line breaks, missing padding and a data: URI prefix.

encode.url_encode.name: URL encode component
encode.url_encode.description: Percent-encodes everything except letters, digits and - . _ ~, for use inside a query value or path segment.

encode.url_encode_full.name: URL encode full URL
encode.url_encode_full.description: Encodes only characters that are not allowed in a URL and keeps its structure and existing %XX sequences.

encode.url_decode.name: URL decode
encode.url_decode.description: Decodes %XX sequences and reports a malformed sequence at its position.

encode.hex_encode.name: Hex encode
encode.hex_encode.description: Writes the UTF-8 bytes of the text as hexadecimal digits.

encode.hex_decode.name: Hex decode
encode.hex_decode.description: Turns hexadecimal digits back into text, ignoring spaces and 0x prefixes.

encode.html_encode.name: HTML entities encode
encode.html_encode.description: Replaces & < > " and ' with HTML entities, and optionally every non-ASCII character with a numeric reference.

encode.html_decode.name: HTML entities decode
encode.html_decode.description: Decodes all HTML5 named entities and numeric references; unknown entities stay as written.

encode.backslash_escape.name: Backslash escape
encode.backslash_escape.description: Escapes backslashes, double quotes, line breaks, tabs and control characters, C and JSON style.

encode.backslash_unescape.name: Backslash unescape
encode.backslash_unescape.description: Turns \n, \t, \", \uXXXX, \xXX and similar escapes back into characters; unknown escapes stay as written with a warning.

encode.unicode_escape.name: Unicode escape
encode.unicode_escape.description: Writes every non-ASCII character as a \uXXXX escape.

encode.unicode_unescape.name: Unicode unescape
encode.unicode_unescape.description: Turns \uXXXX and \u{...} escapes back into characters and leaves other text unchanged.

case.upper.name: UPPERCASE
case.upper.description: Converts all letters to capitals with full Unicode rules.

case.lower.name: lowercase
case.lower.description: Converts all letters to lowercase with full Unicode rules.

case.title.name: Title Case
case.title.description: Capitalizes words; headline style keeps short words lowercase.

case.sentence.name: Sentence case
case.sentence.description: Capitalizes the first word of each sentence and lowercases the rest.

case.camel.name: camelCase
case.camel.description: Joins words into an identifier that starts lowercase.

case.pascal.name: PascalCase
case.pascal.description: Joins words into an identifier with every word capitalized.

case.swap.name: Swap case
case.swap.description: Turns uppercase letters lowercase and lowercase letters uppercase.

hash.md5.name: MD5 hash
hash.md5.description: MD5 digest, not for security. Hashes the text as UTF-8 exactly as shown, with no newline added.

hash.sha1.name: SHA-1 hash
hash.sha1.description: SHA-1 digest, not for security. Hashes the text as UTF-8 exactly as shown, with no newline added.

hash.sha256.name: SHA-256 hash
hash.sha256.description: SHA-256 digest. Hashes the text as UTF-8 exactly as shown, with no newline added.

hash.sha512.name: SHA-512 hash
hash.sha512.description: SHA-512 digest. Hashes the text as UTF-8 exactly as shown, with no newline added.

hash.crc32.name: CRC-32 checksum
hash.crc32.description: CRC-32 with the IEEE polynomial used by zip and PNG. Hashes the text as UTF-8 exactly as shown, with no newline added.

lines.trim.name: Trim
lines.trim.description: Removes spaces and line breaks from the start and end of the text.

lines.trim_each.name: Trim each line
lines.trim_each.description: Removes spaces at the start, end or both sides of every line.

lines.collapse_whitespace.name: Collapse whitespace
lines.collapse_whitespace.description: Turns runs of spaces and tabs into a single space.

lines.remove_empty.name: Remove empty lines
lines.remove_empty.description: Deletes lines that are empty or hold only spaces.

lines.sort.name: Sort lines
lines.sort.description: Sorts lines alphabetically, naturally, numerically or by length.

lines.dedupe.name: Remove duplicate lines
lines.dedupe.description: Keeps the first occurrence of each line in the original order.

lines.reverse.name: Reverse lines
lines.reverse.description: Puts the lines in the opposite order.

lines.join.name: Join lines
lines.join.description: Combines all lines into one with a separator.

lines.unwrap.name: Unwrap paragraphs
lines.unwrap.description: Joins hard-wrapped lines inside paragraphs, as in text copied from PDFs.

lines.prefix.name: Prefix lines
lines.prefix.description: Adds a bullet, number, quote mark or custom text to each line.

clean.invisible.name: Remove invisible characters
clean.invisible.description: Deletes zero-width, bidi and soft-hyphen characters and turns no-break spaces into spaces.

clean.quotes.name: Straighten quotes
clean.quotes.description: Replaces curly quotes with straight ones, and optionally dashes with hyphens.
